title: Tenant baselines
description: Synthetic demo data. One key's signals against their seasonal baseline, the live alert log, Score by key for each region, Notifications the stand-in pager received, and Unit status.

list.name: key
list.label: key
list.query: SELECT key FROM tb.aggregates WHERE ns='live' GROUP BY key ORDER BY sum(count) DESC
list.definition: SELECT key FROM tb.aggregates WHERE ns='live' GROUP BY key ORDER BY sum(count) DESC

list.name: region
list.label: region
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM tb.scores WHERE ns = 'live' ORDER BY region
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM tb.scores WHERE ns = 'live' ORDER BY region

panels.title: $key: $signal with baseline band
panels.description: Synthetic demo data. The seasonal baseline of the key's hour of the week (or its region's or the global one while the key is cold). The dashed line is the median, for volume the expected 5-minute sum. The band is 4 spreads either side of it, the k4 fire level: error rate and latency fire above it, volume below it. Units: error_rate is a fraction of requests, latency_p95 is milliseconds, volume_5m is requests in 5 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT minute AS time, value, median, median + 4 * spread AS upper,
       if(isNull(median), NULL, greatest(median - 4 * spread, 0)) AS lower
FROM tb.scores FINAL
WHERE ns = 'live' AND key = '${key}' AND signal = '${signal}'
  AND minute >= $__fromTime AND minute <= $__toTime
ORDER BY time

SELECT event_time, state, detector, setting, signal, key, value, reference, reason, scope,
    region, starts_at, emitted_at, alert_id
FROM tb.alert_log FINAL
WHERE ns = 'live'
ORDER BY event_time DESC, alert_id, state
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Score by key: $region
panels.description: Synthetic demo data. One row per key. Each cell is the highest score of the key's three signals in 5 minutes, against the live seasonal setting: yellow from 2 (the resolve level), red from 4 (the fire level). A regional incident shows as a block; one tenant's as one row.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(minute, INTERVAL 5 minute) AS time, key, max(score) AS score
FROM tb.scores FINAL
WHERE ns = 'live' AND region = '${region}' AND minute >= $__fromTime AND minute <= $__toTime
GROUP BY time, key ORDER BY time, key

panels.title: Notifications (latest 100, from pager-sink)
panels.description: Synthetic demo data. What Alertmanager sent to the stand-in pager, one row per alert in each notification. Read from pager-sink's log over HTTP, not from a table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT parseDateTime64BestEffort(received_at, 3, 'UTC') AS received, * EXCEPT (received_at)
FROM url('http://pager-sink:8099/notifications', 'JSONEachRow', 'received_at String, receiver String, status String, alertname String, scope String, region String, tenant String, unit String, signal String, detector String, setting String, starts_at String, ends_at String')
ORDER BY received DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Unit status (live)
panels.description: Synthetic demo data. Published only: nothing acts on a drain. A drained unit keeps the signal and reason it was first drained for until it undrains. Volume alerts never drain a unit, and no unit is drained during a regional alert.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT unit, region, argMax(status, at) AS last_status, argMax(signal, at) AS last_signal,
       argMax(reason, at) AS last_reason, max(at) AS since
FROM tb.unit_status FINAL
WHERE ns = 'live'
GROUP BY unit, region ORDER BY since DESC
